column1: # The witnesses of the tests, one row for each rule that a test pins.
# The law: each row changes its file, and its check fails with its text. A row that changes nothing is
# NOOP, a check that passes is SURVIVED, and a check that fails with another text is WRONG_DEATH. Run the
# rows with `scripts/mutants.sh <tree>`, on a copy of the files. A pass that deletes a test, or moves the
# rule of a row, finds the row that no longer dies.
# A row has five fields, separated by a tab:
#   id      the pass that wrote the row, then the rule that the row changes
#   file    the file that the expression changes, from the root of the tree
#   check   a command, run at the root of the copy, that must fail with the text
#   text    a text of the output of the check: the name of a test, or an error code with its message.
#           The text holds no line number and no count.
